summary: Trinity leads Neo down the hall of the thirteenth floor and they stop outside room 1313. She tells him 'This is it.' Then she gives him one piece of advice: be honest, because 'He understands more than you could ever guess.' Meanwhile Neo can hear his own heart pounding.
